acceptance: GATE: The report-only item's recorded data show a projected false-block rate under 1% of PR runs at the chosen thresholds; the chosen thresholds and the data are recorded here before the flip

VERIFY: A throwaway draft PR adding a module-scoped autouse fixture that sleeps is blocked by core with the duration step named; a throwaway PR adding 50 ordinary fast tests is not blocked; both closed afterwards with run ids recorded
VERIFY: For 7 days after the flip, every core failure caused by the step is reviewed and classified true or false positive; false-positive rate stays under 1% or the item reverts to report mode
GUARDRAIL: Rollback is setting mode=report in the policy file (tested); the required-context set does not change; baseline bumps in a PR are visible in its diff

context: Source: CI time-regression incident of 2026-10-25 and an independent adversarial review of the prevention plan. PR #3423 added an autouse module-scoped fixture (tests/conftest.py, _chdb_connections_closed_after_module) that opened a chDB probe session after every module; the fast-tier pytest time went from 327.81 s (run 40143597290) to 1041.10 s (run 40195371347) and PR CI wall time from about 12 to 20+ minutes for about 18 hours before anyone noticed. No CI check measured test time: _project/scripts/fast_lane_ceiling_check.py checks marker composition only, and tests/duration_policy.py's per-test T1 budget is refreshed from nightly data and never sees module-teardown cost spread across tests. Pre-incident fast-job wall time varied 7.8-18.0 min (cv about 19%), so job wall time cannot be a blocking signal; summed per-test junit time is the blocking metric.
description: Enforcement. Set the policy file to mode=block so core fails when summed intersection time exceeds baseline by more than the threshold (provisionally +15% AND +60 s; final value max(2 x measured p99 spread, 10%) with a floor of 60 s), the same rule per medium shard, or when the new-test allowance is exceeded. The only escape hatch is updating the baseline in the PR with the refresh script and stating the reason in the PR body; no label or comment bypass.
